afterEntry.reportText:
DEMO / SAMPLE DEVICE

Find the next safe step

This sample shows a recovery check that needs review before an approved update.

READINESS REPORT / SAMPLE
device-6f31a0b2 · Android 15 (sample)
83% · Fix one item before recovery
Authorized USB debugging
READY

One authorized sample device is visible to adb.
Next: Keep the authorization prompt accepted while checking.

Developer options
READY

Developer options are enabled.
Next: Leave this unchanged for approved maintenance.

USB data mode
READY

The sample device exposes adb over USB.
Next: Use a data-capable cable if this changes.

Free data storage
READY

2.8 GiB free on /data. The 1 GiB safety floor is met.
Next: Keep the floor before copying an update.

Package signer match
READY

The installed sample signer SHA-256 matches the expected approved signer.
Next: Keep the approved APK and signer digest with this report.

Recovery update visibility
NEEDS REVIEW

A/B update support is visible, but Android cannot safely prove recovery sideload status while running.
Next: Read your device’s approved recovery instructions before using recovery.

Recovery checklist
Keep the approved APK and its known-good version.
Record the app package and signer before an update.
Stop after an error and save the report before retrying.
Run this on your device

Install the command, connect one authorized device, then run sideload-readiness check. The demo never reads a device.

See install options
